seo.title: Barbershop Card Fees: What You Really Pay per Payment
seo.description: Card fees cost a barbershop more than the headline rate suggests. How fixed fees, card mix and split payments add up, and why you can't surcharge.

media.anchor: # The 20p You Don't Notice: How Card Fees Really Work for a Barbershop
media.alt: Graphic of a twenty-pence fixed processing fee on every card payment, with editorial KERSIVO typography.
media.caption: Original KERSIVO Insights illustration. The 20p refers to the published example online card processing fee.
media.rights: Original KERSIVO-authored SVG based on the Notion card-fees draft; no third-party images, people, branding or trademarks.

media.anchor: The headline rate is 1.5%, but a £12 kids' cut costs more than twice that.
media.alt: Illustrative fee share at 1.5% plus 20p: 3.17% on a £12 cut, 2.30% on a £25 cut and 2.00% on a £40 cut.
media.caption: Worked examples from the article, not estimates of any particular barbershop's fee statement.
media.rights: Original KERSIVO-authored SVG with numbers derived from the source article.
